observations.summary: Reuters reports President Zelenskyy said Ukrainian naval drones sank Russian corvette Merkury in Benghazi on November 22, struck cargo ship MV Angara, and destroyed a Ka-27 helicopter. The ship damage was previously reported; the new material development is Ukraine's public attribution and additional claims, not a second independent attack. Russia had not commented. Details of helicopter and second ship damage are not independently established.
observations.title: Ukraine publicly claims Benghazi Russian corvette attack
